_comment: Live game state. This is the ONLY file that changes week to week.
episode      = the episode about to air (picks are for this one).
merged       = true once one tribe remains. Set it explicitly; never infer it.
tribes       = player id -> tribe name. Fill in after the premiere.
eliminated   = player ids already voted out, in boot order.
edit         = player id -> -1..1 doom signal from the latest episode.
idols        = player ids known to hold an idol or immunity advantage.
my_draft     = the castaways actually drafted onto my roster (2 slots).
my_mvp       = my sole-survivor pick.
draft_preference_order = what was submitted to draft.html on 2026-09-17,
best to worst, via tools/submit.py. The draft itself is a snake auto-draft
at Sep 23 8:00 PM EDT (data/site/draft.html), not an immediate pick, so
my_draft stays [] until the site actually assigns the 2 roster slots.
Re-run 'python3 tools/submit.py verify' after the draft to read the result
and fill my_draft in by hand.
